nodes.description: Deployer constructor that mints the whole supply, sets owner = msg.sender and grants unlimited allowance to the router 0x7a25...
Token transfer entrypoint that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Whitelist check combining owner, UNI, pair-derived and canSale exemptions with the sale condition gate.
Core transfer logic mutating allowance, balanceOf and _onSaleNum without SafeMath.
Sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
Sale gating logic reading _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only arbitrary delegatecall to attacker supplied address and calldata.
Owner-only initialization of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch transfer looping over _tos and doing unchecked balance arithmetic.
Owner-only setter for the privileged tradeAddress whitelist slot.
Uniswap-pair CREATE2 address derivation used by ensure.
Public balance mapping mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested allowance mapping read and mutated in transferFrom and approve.
Total token supply scaled by 10**decimals in the constructor.
Privileged owner address acting as sole access-control guard.
Whitelisted trading address that bypasses sale restrictions in ensure.
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and read by condition.
Mapping of addresses allowed to sell regardless of the condition gate.
Minimum sell amount enforced by condition.
Maximum sell amount enforced by condition.
Maximum number of sales per address enforced by condition.
Constant token decimals (18) used in supply scaling.
Token name set in the constructor.
Token symbol set in the constructor.
Constant hardcoded Uniswap router address exempted from sale restrictions.
Caller-controlled address used for allowances, ownership checks and balance accounting.
Low-level delegatecall into an arbitrary address and calldata supplied by the owner.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total that can underflow.
Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value inside the batch loop.
Source address parameter of ensure, checked against owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale.
Recipient address parameter of transfer/transferFrom receiving the credited balance.
Amount parameter of transfer/transferFrom used for allowance, balance and sale checks.
Arbitrary target address parameter of delegate passed to delegatecall.
Arbitrary calldata parameter of delegate passed to delegatecall.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used to derive allowance[_from][msg.sender] in transferFrom, so the caller controls spender authorization.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender], directly controlled by the caller.
delegate guards on msg.sender == owner, so caller identity decides who may trigger the delegatecall.
init guards on msg.sender == owner before rewriting sale limits.
batchSend guards on msg.sender == owner and debits balanceOf[msg.sender].
setTradeAddress guards on msg.sender == owner before writing the whitelist slot.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the whole access-control model.
transfer simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom requires ensure(_from, _to, _value) before moving balances.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
transferFrom debits balanceOf[_from] and credits balanceOf[_to] with unchecked math.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] to count completed transfers.
ensure falls through to require(condition(_from, _value)) for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address for the token.
ensure grants a bypass when _from == owner or _to == owner, keying on the privileged owner state.
ensure compares _from against the hardcoded UNI router constant.
ensure grants a bypass when _from == tradeAddress, an owner-settable whitelist entry.
ensure grants a bypass when canSale[_from] is true, bypassing the sale gate.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against the _saleNum quota.
condition reads _saleNum to bound the number of allowed sales.
condition reads _minSale to enforce the minimum sell amount.
condition reads _maxSale to enforce the maximum sell amount.
delegate executes an external delegatecall to attacker supplied address and calldata, allowing arbitrary code to run in the token context.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before performing the delegatecall.
batchSend reads and writes balanceOf for the sender and every recipient.
batchSend performs unchecked subtraction balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total.
batchSend performs unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value inside the loop.
init recomputes _minSale from the token parameter.
init recomputes _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
init writes the new _saleNum quota.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist slot used by ensure.
constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
constructor assigns the entire supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
constructor grants uint(-1) allowance to the router address.
constructor sets totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals.
constructor stores _name.
constructor stores _symbol.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _from is only a value carrier for the owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale checks inside ensure and should be folded into that function node.
Parameter _to only feeds the balanceOf credit in transferFrom and should be normalized into the transferFrom function node.
Parameter _value is used for the allowance, balance and sale comparisons in transferFrom and should be merged into that function node.
Parameter a is the delegatecall target address and is consumed directly by the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Parameter b is the delegatecall calldata and is consumed directly by the delegatecall unsafe operation.
